sourceTitle: Mary Queen of Scots Makers of History
description: "Mary Queen of Scots" by Jacob Abbott is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The book chronicles the life of Mary Stuart, who became Queen of Scotland shortly after her birth and later navigated the complex political landscape between Protestant England and Catholic France.
